name: Vitamin B12
overview: Vitamin B12 is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include vitamin b12, also known as cobalamin or extrinsic factor, is a water-soluble vitamin involved in metabolism; one of eight b vitamins, it serves as a vital cofactor in dna synthesis and both fatty acid and amino acid metabolism; it plays an essential role in the nervous system by supporting myelin synthesis and is critical for the maturation of red blood cells in the bone marrow. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
